ItemID: NA; Title: Vivaldi: The Four Seasons; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My recent relaxing classical listening makes this a strong choice for unwinding.
ItemID: NA; Title: III; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone gives me too little indication that it fits my current taste.
ItemID: NA; Title: Songs For While I’m Away + The Boys Are Back In Town (Live)[CD/DVD/Blu-ray]; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in soothing orchestral music and polished vocal performances right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Partners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Barbra Streisand’s vocal duets fit my interest in musical theatre and crossover singing.
ItemID: NA; Title: Skool Luv Affair (Incl. 115-Page Photobook and One Random Rhotocard); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This does not connect closely enough with the classical and vocal albums I have been choosing.
ItemID: NA; Title: Harry Chapin: The Story Of A Life; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A retrospective of storytelling songs is less appealing today than orchestral or crossover vocals.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blurryface Special; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its alternative pop and rock direction does not suit the relaxed listening I want now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Best of Jackie Gleason & His Orchestra: His Original Capitol Recordings; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Gentle orchestral arrangements sound well suited to my recent relaxing classical listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Hundred Highways; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Although I have listened to country albums, I am not drawn to this spare, reflective style today.
ItemID: NA; Title: All That Echoes; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I enjoyed choosing Stages, so another Josh Groban album is a particularly strong fit.
